# Getting started with Widget Manager

Welcome to Widget Manager. This guide walks you through creating your first widget and getting comfortable with the workspace.

## Creating your first widget

To create a widget, click the **+ New widget** button in the top-right of the dashboard. You'll be asked to choose a widget type — start with **Basic** for a generic, configurable widget. Give your widget a name (between 3 and 60 characters) and an optional description.

Once created, the widget appears in your dashboard and is editable immediately. Drafts auto-save every 10 seconds; you don't need to publish to keep your work.

## Publishing a widget

When your widget is ready, click **Publish** in the top-right. Published widgets are visible to anyone in your workspace with view access. Drafts are private to you until published.

You can unpublish any widget at any time by clicking **Unpublish** from the same menu. Unpublishing immediately removes the widget from the workspace view but preserves all its content.

## Workspace and dashboard

Your workspace is the top-level container for all your widgets. Inside the workspace, the dashboard shows your widgets organized by category (see *Managing widget categories* for how to set those up). Each widget tile shows its name, last-edit time, and a small preview.

Use the search bar at the top of the dashboard to find widgets by name, description, or content.

# Managing widget categories

Categories let you organize widgets into logical groups. Every widget belongs to exactly one category.

## Creating a category

To create a category, go to **Settings → Categories** and click **+ New category**. Each category needs a name (max 40 characters) and an optional color label. Colors are purely visual and don't affect filtering or permissions.

You can create up to 50 categories per workspace.

## Assigning a widget to a category

You can assign a category when creating a widget, or change it later by editing the widget and selecting a new category from the dropdown at the top. Widgets without a category land in the default **Uncategorized** bucket.

## Reordering categories

Categories appear on the dashboard in the order you set under **Settings → Categories**. Drag-and-drop reordering is supported. The default category (**Uncategorized**) is always pinned to the bottom and cannot be moved.

## Deleting a category

Deleting a category does not delete its widgets — they're moved to **Uncategorized**. You'll be asked to confirm before deletion. If you want to delete the widgets too, do that first.

# Sharing widgets with your team

Widget Manager supports two sharing modes: **workspace-wide** (every workspace member can see the widget) and **explicit sharing** (only listed users).

## Sharing with the whole workspace

The default for a published widget is workspace-wide visibility. Anyone in your workspace can find, view, and search the widget. Only the widget owner (and workspace admins) can edit it.

To change a widget from workspace-wide to explicit sharing, open the widget and go to **Share → Visibility → Specific people**.

## Explicit sharing

In **Specific people** mode, you add users one at a time. Each user can be granted **View**, **Comment**, or **Edit** permission. Permissions are widget-level: a user who can edit one widget can't necessarily edit another.

Adding a user sends them a notification. You can revoke access at any time from the same Share panel.

## Sharing with external users

External users (people outside your workspace) can be invited via email through **Share → Invite external**. They receive a link valid for 7 days. External users can only view, never edit, even if you grant Edit permission — that's a hard product limit and cannot be changed.
